newsitem.title: USA: Interphase, Bell Microproducts in pact.
newsitem.headline: Interphase, Bell Microproducts in pact.

text.p: Interphase Corp said on Wednesday that it signed a deal with Bell Microproducts Inc to distribute Bell's entire line of mass storage adaptor products.

Interphase, which supplies local area network, wide-area network and mass storage technologies, said the deal enables it to expand the market for its Fibre Channel technology by establishing a distribution channel solely for resellers and system integrators that provide high-speed data back-up, server clustering and disk mirroring solutions.
Bell also specializes in other products, such as hard disk drives and optical drives, that complement the Fibre Channel line, Interphase said.
Interphase shares were trading down 1/16 to 6-5/16 on Wednesday, while Bell Microproducts was off 7/8 to 10-1/8.
